difficulty: Specialty · Hands-on experience in the domain recommended
prerequisites: None (recommended: 2+ years of experience developing and running ML/deep learning workloads)

faq.q: How many questions are on the MLS-C01 exam, and how long is it?
faq.a: MLS-C01 has 65 questions and a time limit of 180 minutes. Questions are multiple choice and multiple response.
You need 750 or higher out of 1000 to pass. The score is a scaled score adjusted for question difficulty, so it is not the same as a simple percentage of correct answers.

faq.q: How much does the exam cost and how do I register?
faq.a: The exam fee is $300 USD, and you can take it through Pearson VUE at a test center or as an online proctored exam. There is no free retake, so you pay the full fee each time you sit the exam.

faq.q: How long is the certification valid? How do I recertify?
faq.a: The certification is valid for 3 years after you pass, and you must recertify before it expires. When you pass, you receive a 50% discount voucher for your next exam, which you can use for recertification or for another AWS certification exam.

faq.q: Can I take the exam in Korean?
faq.a: Yes, it is offered in 4 languages in total, including Korean. You can choose your language when you register for the exam.
